result.markdown: --- title: "Week 6: Exponential smoothing" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ## What you will learn this week * Exponential smoothing methods with trend and seasonality * ETS models * Automatic model selection using the AICc ## Pre-class activities Read [Sections 8.3-8.7 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/expsmooth.html) and watch all embedded videos. ## Slides for seminar Download pdf ## [Workshop activities](activities.qmd) ## Seminar Code ::: {.callout appearance="minimal"} [week6-code.R](week6-code.R){download="week6-code.R"} ::: ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives 1. **Compare alternative ETS model structures**. - Select and fit different ETS models (e.g., ETS(A,N,N) vs ETS(A,A,N)). - Evaluate and compare their fit (e.g., RMSE). - Interpret forecast differences and prediction intervals, and justify model choice based on empirical performance. 2. **Select and justify appropriate ETS models for seasonal data**. - Able to identify when multiplicative seasonality (and optional damped trend) is necessary. 3. **Compare multiple forecasting methods using training/test splits and cross-validation**. - Use training/test sets and cross-validation to fit and compare a range of methods (ETS, transformed ETS, seasonal naïve, STL + ETS). 4. **Evaluate ETS method and identify its limitations**. - Apply ETS model, assess forecasting quality, and recognise cases where ETS may not perform well and explain why. ::: - Complete Exercises 5, 7, 11, 14 from [Section 8.8 of the book](https://otexts.com/fpp3/expsmooth-exercises.html). ## Assignments * [GA2](../assignments/G2.qmd) is due on Tuesday 14 April. * [IA3](../assignments/A3.qmd) is due on Friday 24 April. ## Weekly quiz * Week 6 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400140) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5402233) — Due Wednesday 15 April.
